svg.title: Build independently, then check agreement
svg.desc: The same data, data dictionary and analysis specification feed two fresh headless sessions. Each agent builds its own scripts and saves results without seeing the other's code or results. R and Python logos identify software, not agent providers. A third headless agent compares the outputs. A worksheet reports agreement for selected saved heat-and-birthweight checks: record membership, the mean 10-versus-5-hot-day contrast and its standard error. Numerical agreement uses full precision and the specification's tolerance, not rounded displayed values. If results disagree, the agent in session C determines the cause of the disagreement. R logo © 2016 The R Foundation, CC BY-SA 4.0; Python logo is a trademark of the Python Software Foundation.

g.text: The agent compares IDs exactly and checks full-precision
results against the specification’s numerical tolerance.

svg.text: If results disagree, ask the agent in session C
to determine the cause of the disagreement.
